sources.title: qwen2.5-7b-standard-step-dpo-10k-4ep - FriendliAI
sources.snippet: The model was trained on 10,000 standard Step-DPO preference pairs sampled deterministically with seed 42. Each pair contains a mathematical problem, a reasoning prefix ending at Step N:, a chosen replacement step from a continuation that reached the reference answer, and the original erroneous step as the rejected response.
